palette_rules.editorial-clean: Tight transients, crisp air >3kHz, low-mud controlled whooshes, room-tone beds.
palette_rules.kinetic-street: Glitch textures, punchy low-mid impacts paired with high mechanical whips.
palette_rules.organic-cinema: Foley materials (paper, wood, glass, metal, deep boom) & Emotional Realism contrast.
palette_rules.comedic-dry: Dry un-reverbed stingers & rapid silence drop-outs before punchlines.
palette_rules.gaming-montage: Sharp transient cutters lock-synced to beat onsets & swept pre-drops.
